summary: Kevin Hassett is Trump’s top White House economic adviser as director of the National Economic Council. An economist long at the American Enterprise Institute, he chaired the Council of Economic Advisers in Trump’s first term. He was considered for Federal Reserve chair, but Trump nominated Kevin Warsh in January 2026.

connections.name: Stephen Miller
connections.description: Senior White House staff together since January 2025 (Hassett at the National Economic Council, Miller as deputy chief of staff for policy); inferred from their overlapping posts. Hassett reports to Miller as chief of staff from November 9, 2026.
